200 scenarios, both rounds: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS vs ElevenLabs Eleven v4

Every scenario that has a round 1 and a round 2 run. Open a scenario to hear all four clips (Gemini on the left, ElevenLabs on the right; each side's round 1 and round 2 players sit together at the top, details below), with the automatic checks, transcripts and judge scores. Mark what you hear; your marks stay in this browser until you export them.

  • The judge is Gemini 2.5 Flash on Vertex AI - the same vendor as one of the two models - and has been unreliable on what was actually said. Trust the checks and transcripts for wording; listening decides.
  • Outside English a pass covers only length, silence, loudness and the few phrase checks; pronunciation and wording rest on listening and the judge.
  • Voices: every woman is ElevenLabs Matilda / Gemini Aoede, every man Eric / Charon, the older man Bill / Fenrir. Age is not voiced and Matilda is an American voice - an age or accent note is a limit of this cast, not of either model.
  • Licensing: ElevenLabs clips made on Free plan keys (most of round 1 Hinglish and all of round 2) are not licensed for commercial use.

3) "5:30 pm" read as a time
